reviews.title: Delayed 2 hours both ways.
reviews.text: DAT operated our flights both ways to Dublin on behalf of Aer Lingus. The flight to Dublin was delayed almost 2 hours and the return flight was delayed over 2 hours. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Mr

reviews.text: Norwegian made a late switch and offered a DAT plane. Old machine with zero legroom. Avoid this airline and stay away. Worse than the worst charter flights

reviews.title: comfy

reviews.text: The worst airline I’ve flown with in a ling while. Very unfriendly staff, very slow in fixing issues. Will try to avoid them in the future.
reviews.author: Kleio C

reviews.title: Little space between seat rows
reviews.text: Too small distance to the seat in front of you. Had to put my knees in the walkway and steal space from the passenger next to me :( Attentive cabin crew. Good orientation from the captain during flight, and smooth landing Drinks on board are expensive. Some advertised goods were not available
reviews.author: Dennis Slot J

reviews.title: Quick flight
reviews.text: The flight was good, no delay. We landed on time. They served us just a couple of drinks, didn't expect anything more than that.
reviews.author: Carmen R

reviews.title: Friendly airline
reviews.text: This was a rescue flight to replace TCook and not knowing what to expect we were pleased to find the crew were very friendly and ready for a laugh at our time of uncertainty they really put everyone at ease The captain was really good and quite a joker he got everyone laughing we all knew that there was no problem after that there was a slight delay and we had to land in mainland Greece to refuel about an hour we then flew direct to Gatwick the flight was quite pleasent and would have no problem using the airline again well done to the airline and to the crew they did a fantastic job ten out of ten
reviews.author: Keith r48

reviews.title: A new experience
reviews.text: We were going home from Lanzarote, the airplane was delayed and after hours went without notice why, after 3 hours a pilot from Dat came to the gate and gave a speech in Danish that we did not understand anything about. I asked a Danish traveler what the problem was, she said it was a French air strike that was the problem and that 15 passengers could not come along, and no luggage at all. I tried to get an answer from an air hostess but she refused to speak. After four hours the aircraft departed, when we landed I received a text message from our travel company apologizing for the delay due to heavy headwinds. The delay caused us to miss the last train home and forced us to spend the night at hotels in Malmö. The airline Dat refused to pay any compensation at all
reviews.author: Palmis56

reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text: Unlike other domestic airlines, Danish Air Transport serves a cup of coffee or tea on a short route. Distance between seats was OK / good. D.A.T. is known for being among the most precise airlines, and both flights were on time or ahead of schedule. Flight attendants were extremely kind and attentive, the best crews I have experienced for quite some years! Prices are very reasonable.
reviews.author: frpe1960

reviews.title: Fine service
reviews.text: Nice flight, very polite staff. Friendly, smiling and very helpful. They are very effective. allover good service. We can reccoment DAT.
reviews.author: OleJanus

reviews.title: Delayed due to bad weather
reviews.text: I don’t think my flight was representative at all because on that evening all flights were delayed due to thunder and lightening and in addition it was the week of the Danish Peoples meeting attracting thousands of people and Danish politicians, so many people were affected by the delays. I was pleased to be on ground rather than in a jumpy plane. The flight is very short, so I wouldn’t expect any food or entertainment either. DAT managed to exchange the very small plane for bigger ones so more people could fly out once the traffic was back on tracks.
reviews.author: ScaniaSwede

reviews.title: First DAT flight
reviews.text: Old plane - Atr type, little bit worn out inside. Friendly staff, average service. We have short flight, the flight was at time. Previously this route was opereted by Norra, which is partly owned by DAT and Finnair.
reviews.author: mmikko

reviews.title: On time & in budget!
reviews.text: What’s there not to like? The R/T cost was affordable at under $165. The check-in counter opened 2 hours before flight departure. They were nice enough to take a carry-on bag and check it for me, making my 1-hour flight even more comfortable. The flight took off and landed right on time with the flight crew making a pass to hand out refreshments. I only wish my long haul flights went this smoothly!
reviews.author: salEdawgz

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Great experience with this company. The flight lasted less that an hour. I ttavelles with a 6 months old baby and I felt very welcomed and helped by the staff. The male stuart was very kind and made us smile in different occasions. Dedinitely a good company
reviews.author: Inspire722081

reviews.title: No problem at all...
reviews.text: Nice plane. Good food. The staff very friendly We have travelled with this airline several times, and never had any complaint.
reviews.author: Torben R

reviews.title: Nice flight
reviews.text: Nice flight, but small leg space, but ok for a short flight - went for a holiday with Apollo. Very Nice staff, but the flight food just ok
reviews.author: Ole P

reviews.title: Convenient, comfortable and punctual
reviews.text: We did a short hop from Mid Jutland to Copenhagen, and it was a very pleasurable way to do the journey. We have taken the train in the past, but this was a good alternative. super easy, personable and quick check in and security. Boarding on time and a lovely flight across Denmark, where this time we were low enough and the weather was on our side to see loads of features.
reviews.author: Kurt P

reviews.title: Good domestic airline
reviews.text: I flew with DAT from Copenhagen to Bornholm and back. Great service and chilled atmosphere. On plane free snacks were really strong liquorice which I passed on.
reviews.author: Brodie Knibbs

reviews.title: Flight delayed? We'll never tell you.
reviews.text: I was traveling back to mainland Italy from Pantelleria this summer. I had a DAT flight after 9am which was due to arrive in Palermo at 10:25am. I was then taking an Alitalia flight to Milan and was supposed to meet my husband in Portofino that afternoon in Portofino. My DAT flight was late and I was given no notice until after the flight was already late and was informed by airport staff that the flight was cancelled and would fly out later. This required me to reschedule my flight for later in the day. I was then informed my DAT flight would leave after 11am. I then revised my Alitalia flight and train ticket. I had to pay for a new ticket on Alitalia. The DAT flight was again (with no notice) and ultimately did not leave Pantelleria until much later in the day, causing me to purchase another ticket out of Palermo to Milan. This cost me almost $700 USD in new ticket costs. As there were no trains from Milan to the Portofino area at that time, my husband had to drive to Milan from Portofino and pick me up at the airport so that we could then turn around and drive back to Portofino, arriving after 1am. Additionally, the DAT plane out of Pantelleria was old and dirty. So, I incurred huge costs due to DAT changing the flight time several times with no notice and I lost an entire day of travel for what should have been a very short flight. I will never ever book travel on DAT again.
reviews.author: nychuman

reviews.title: Danish quality
reviews.text: Flying DAT is a very good alternative to other companies. Flying just in time and very good informative service about where we are. On the way back to Aalborg we even got off 20 min. before scedule. The stewardesses where verry helfull and had a god humor.
reviews.author: carl beck

reviews.title: Simple to Bornholm
reviews.text: Travelled From Karup to Bornholm with a change in Copenhagen. Simple travel domestic Denmark, quick check-in and quick trough the airport on arrival, even if we had checked bagage. Friendly cabin crew and a quick coffee service on both legs.
reviews.author: Michael H

reviews.title: Simple and easy
reviews.text: I booked a flight between London and Copenhagen with SAS and discovered shortly afterwards that this flight would be operated by Danish Air Transport. Check in was simple and easy as it always is through the SAS website. Boarding, however, did seem a bit rushed at times (possibly due to the late inbound flight causing time pressure) Cabin crew were very friendly and presented well - it was hard to tell them apart from a regular SAS crew. The flight departed and arrived perfectly on time. Only one small criticism - the inflight magazines and duty free catalogues are only available in Danish and not in English. However, I understand that this isn’t a frequent route for the airline.
reviews.author: AdamH1999

reviews.title: PLUS is not always PLUS.
reviews.text: This was the worst trip ever. So tight between the rows so I couldn’t even move. DAT was the carrier but booked with SAS.

reviews.title: very tight space

reviews.author: hogsted

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Was flying with DAT for the first time. Hope it will not be the last. The service on board was excellent and.... entertaining :-) . The crew was very informative as well. No complaints, apart from the delay which DAT could not do anyting about ...
reviews.author: Svartepaja

reviews.title: Fast way to get from Copenhagen to Jutland
reviews.text: Had stop i Copenhagen of less than 1 hour on our way from Bornholm to Karup. Both fligth with DAT and the gates were just next to each other, so no long walks in the Airport. Nice waiting area and good info. Boarding well in time and the full aircraft took of on time. Again smal aircraft but for this short fligth of 45 minuts it is ok. Clean aircraft with service minded and smilling staff. Coffee and the served. Nice fligth and save landing in Karup. Suitcases delivered fast after landing. Will fly DAT again.
reviews.author: Danes55

reviews.title: Easy fligth
reviews.text: Flying with DAT from Bornholm was a very good experience. Nice airport with serviceminded staff, fast check in and boarding. Small aircraft, but good service and safe fligth. Space not that big, but for a fligth of 30 minuts it is very much ok. We can only recommend DAT as airline if you want to go to and from Bornholm in a fast way. We will fly again next time.
reviews.author: Danes55

reviews.title: Short fligth
reviews.text: This trip was in connection with a short stopover in Copenhagen, bording fast and easy. Machine one of the new ATR72 with a bit more space for the legs and the inside looked nice. Take of in time and a very nice fligth, well informed and coffee served with a smile. Arrived before scedule and we had a nice landing. Suitcases came prompt. We will use this airline again.
reviews.author: Danes55

reviews.title: Good Fligth
reviews.text: Early morning fligth, security and check in fast and smooth. Boarding in time and ready to take of before time. Aircraft one of the older ATR 72 with entering in the front! Machine looked some what old. Well informed by staff and take off in time. Pilot informed about some thunder clouds with rain which could give some turbolens, but we had a super fligth and the pilots did a nice job and did awoid the turbulens. Coffee served and after 45 minuts a very good landing on time. Can only recomend this airline.
reviews.author: Danes55

reviews.title: Very serviceminde staff
reviews.text: It is a low fare company so no drinks or food was included in the trip, but the staff was very helpful in every way, giving us pillows and blankets, letting us change seats, etc, and the captain gave information about interesting points that we passed
reviews.author: brit933

reviews.title: Two trips in one!
reviews.text: With this airline you don't just get a trip in the air, but also a trip back in time, so basically mr Rungholm gives you 2 trips for the price of one! DAT uses some ancient ATR aircraft on their scheduled short haul routes in Norway (to Ørland and Stord) and Denmark (Bornholm and Karup): the aircraft used on OSL-OLA is 32 years old by now. The aircraft have an interior that's pretty 'retro' nowadays. It looks old, feels old and smells old. But it definitely feels safe onboard. For onboard service, don't expect much. And why should you, on trips that are under one hour? No serving, no entertainment, no wifi or anything alike. But then again, on flgihts that are well under one hour, why should you need all that? The flight attendant and flight deck do their jobs and make sure that the flights are as uneventful as possible. For aviation, I think that's a very good thing. If I get there safe and on time, I'm happy. Some points for improvment would be to get some newer and hopefully quieter aircraft, as well as getting some lower flight prices on some of the routes, at least in Norway. Apart from that, I'd certainly fly again with this airline.
reviews.author: Arne V

reviews.title: Cattle class
reviews.text: We flew from Barcelona to Rotterdam with a replacing airline, DAT, the service was very friendly. The seats however are very near each other. That didn't make it more comfortable.
reviews.author: francien2015

reviews.title: Fine charter flight
reviews.text: We expected DAT to be a low service (pay for any service company) and the expectations were fully as expected, and that is OK. Check in was a little confusion as the destination were Preveza but the check in desk said Lefkas. We had to ask, and it showed up that it was same place. Seating space is a little urge but that was also expected, so OK for a 2½ hour flight. We got a fine flight back and forth with no delays so all in all OK.

reviews.title: Another Package trip!
reviews.text: Once again we used DAT to fly to Mallorca Spain. For the price that we paid it was OK. It was the cheaper end of any airline in Europe, not much of a seat but it was only 3 hours. The point about the trip id the very poor airport of Aarhus it has been the same for 30 years .

reviews.text: The flight was good and smooth with a very soft landing. Being a package holiday do not expect a real service or any comfort.

reviews.title: On time
reviews.text: Domestic from Karup Saturday morning. No hazzle smal friendly airport. DAT's gates at Copenhagen are about the closest you can get to the "outside world"! (trains etc.). So easily made my meeting at Roskilde at 10:00. Return Sunday morning. CPH - KAR. Ooops. Security. Still Holiday season and long lines. But really no delay if you do as you're told.Putting liquids in a clear bag etc. Lots of "small helpers" before the line offering the "correct" plastic bag. Nice touch. Back to DAT. Appreciate the serving of coffe/ tea on such a short flight. Best of all - they are running "on time"!

reviews.text: I flew ATR fly before and I think they are comfortable except the propeller noise. Very nice staff. The only route they have is this one to Stord. Miss the route to Fagernes but this is it.

reviews.title: Old dirty plane with Poor seats
reviews.text: The flight was operated for Norwegian airline from Budapest to Copenhagen. Check in and boarding was smooth. Apart from that everything was nightmare. The flight itself smelled bad and the seats are very small and uncomfortable. The is no place to keep your even your small water bottle. Probably the worst flight i ever travelled.
reviews.author: Ramya M

reviews.title: My home up in the clouds!
reviews.text: I always take this airline when traveling from Northern Jutland to Copenhagen, where I could take a connecting flight to another part of the world or just to visit friends in Copenhagen. Being welcomed by the crew always with a smile and a pleasant greeting feels like coming home. Despite the short duration of the flight, there is always time for a free cup of coffee or tea accompanied by chocolate licorice again served by the gracious staff. I have never experienced any delays or inconveniences during the many years, I have flown with this airline, even when it was still doing flights for Norwegian Air. You can have your luggage checked in through your final destination, if your connecting flight is with Scandinavian Airlines. Furthermore, there is free check in of luggage up to 23 kg. per person. The aircraft is not so big, so for tall people, leg room could be a problem. Nevertheless, the flight cost is even cheaper than a bus or train ticket, if you book your flights in good time, and the flight takes only 45 minutes. There is free seating, so if you have preferred seats, board as early as possible. DAT is definitely the best budget airline in this part of the world.
reviews.author: Gloria A

reviews.title: Charter flight for Aarhus Charter,Travel agency.
reviews.text: Efficient, Friendly and smiling staff. Flight was on time.Clean planes, economy seating, no inflight entertainment. Airbus A320 out and home. Home flight on OY-JRZ was more noisy at take off.
